snippet.title: Chinese Frontiers - FULL LAUNCH Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Chinese Frontiers now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1640820/Chinese_Frontiers/

Chinese Frontiers has landed on Steam! 🐲

Chinese Frontiers is a builder and survival game where the player rises from a humble villager to a master builder, constructing parts of the Great Wall of China and other iconic landmarks.
